Using official Terraform AWS module — source + version auto-included.
Full VPC with subnets, NAT gateways, route tables in one call.
enable_nat_gateway=true for private subnet outbound traffic.
Outputs vpc_id, private_subnets, public_subnets for other resources.
Use single_nat_gateway=false in production for HA.
